scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “The circulant Hadamard conjecture” (preprints/The-circulant-Hadamard-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 179 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 68f1d360a8623873), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For a positive integer n, a real circulant Hadamard matrix of order n exists if and only if n ∈ {1, 4}.
